_doc: Shared in-game script blocks kept identical by tools/blocks_sync.py (control_arch D8). One entry per block: file = the block text (marker comments included), scripts = the scripts/*.cs files that carry it, anchor = regex of the line the block is inserted before when a script has none yet (default ^public Program\(\)), name = the marker word (markers are '// >>> NAME v...' and '// <<< NAME v...'). The seven blocks that predate this file keep their own tools/*_sync.py (lists inside); blocks_sync.py --check runs them too, so ONE command checks every shared block. New blocks (MANUAL, BATTERY, HELMLINK, ...) are added here, not as an eighth hard-coded sync script.
